surface_mechanism_description: Oxygen atoms are created at Pt surfaces by dissociative chemisorption reactions of O2 and these oxygen atoms oxidatively decompose MeCpPtMe3 molecules when these are exposed to the surface.
evidence: In this process, oxygen atoms are created at Pt surfaces by dissociative chemisorption reactions of O2 and these oxygen atoms oxidatively decompose MeCpPtMe3 molecules when these are exposed to the surface.
